stages.text: Board your courier at the dock and leave Kestrel Reach.

one_way_message.text: First line: 'If you're reading this, you already left the ring. Good. Don't file a flight plan.' Step on the dock portal and press G to board.

stages.text: The note names a dead relay in the Tessellate system - jump there.

one_way_message.text: Second line: 'Tessellate. The old relay station - it still holds air, and someone still lives in it. Ask them about the survey.' Pick Tessellate on the star map and jump (V).

stages.text: Dock at the Tessellate relay station.

one_way_message.text: The relay's on a slow tumble but the dock still lights up. Match it and set down (L).

stages.text: Find the archivist who knew Elian and hear what they have.

one_way_message.text: Third line: 'Whoever's keeping the relay logs knew me. They kept the last thing I sent back. Read it before you decide anything.'

stages.text: The note's last line points past the edge - jump to the Verge.

one_way_message.text: Last line, not a place: 'If it's still talking when you get there, it isn't me anymore. Come anyway. The Verge - the moon with the settlement. I'll have left the light on.'

stages.text: Land at the settlement on the Verge moon.

one_way_message.text: There's one settled moon in the Verge and one lit pad on it. Set down.
The note ends here. Whatever's on the far side of the plaza, you came a long way to hear it out.
